title: Shell mega menu and account polish
summary: The top menu now shows every section after the logo on phones and desktops, with clearer drop-down panels. Admins switch between Staff and Admin from the account menu, menus are easier to read, and pages use more of the screen width.

added: Top-level menu sections after the logo open wider mega panels with section headings.
changed: Menu sections stay visible after the logo on one row (scroll sideways on very narrow screens).
Home goes straight to the dashboard; other sections still open mega menus.
Admins open Staff panel or Admin panel from the account menu instead of a switch beside the logo.
Account and menu panels use a solid background so the text is easier to read.
Page content uses 95% of the screen width.
removed: The hamburger Open menu button and the side drawer that copied the old left menu.
accessibility: Keyboard users still open and close mega panels and the account menu with Enter, Space and Escape.

internal_notes: Epic #375. Shipped #376 always-visible mega menus; #377 Staff/Admin in account menu; #378 opaque panels and 95% content width; #383 Home link and single-row top nav.
